messages:
alex: Proposal: Novaplex Dedicated upgrade window -> Fri 2026-04-02 02:00 UTC. Change: runtime v3.5.2 -> v3.6.0 (kernel fusion + stable kv-policy), quant profile q5_beta to reduce CPU for embeddings. Canary plan: 2% for 15m, then 10% for 30m, then 100% over 10m. Rollback conditions: +1.0% absolute error rate OR p95 latency +40ms sustained for 5m. Rollback target: v3.5.2. Need SRE + Ops + PM ack. Release notes: https://internal.redwood/rels/novaplex-v3.6.0

lina: Do we expect any change to cold-start behavior? embeddings workload is bursty overnight.

alex: Benchmarks show embeddings token throughput improves ~8% avg, cold-start p95 roughly flat, but small allocation jitter for first 90s in some cases. We'll add pre-warm and staggered slices.

deploy-bot: PRECHECK OK
 - infra capacity: 140% for ded pool novaplex
 - certs: valid
 - KMS keys: rotation not scheduled in window
 - monitoring: dashboards+alerts present
 - canary quota: ok
Promote command:
`/deploy start --tenant novaplex --version v3.6.0 --canary 2% --canary-duration 15m --window 2026-04-02T02:00:00Z`

sre-tom: SRE note: will add a KV hit-rate dashboard and a short-lived synthetic to exercise embeddings path 5m before canary. I'll be watching p99 tail as well.

ops-lee: Ops request: pin BlueHarbor tenant to v3.5.2 for 48h after deploy (they're on a compliance sync). That should be via routing rule, not slice split. Also add alert routing to #incidents and #ops-night.

alex: Routing pin doable: `tenant.pin.version=3.5.2 ttl=48h BlueHarbor`. Will append runbook.

pm-ana: Please include a section in release notes: customer-facing impact (no schema changes), estimated cost delta with q5_beta, and oncall contacts. Also confirm backup pool shift plan.

alex: Added cost delta (~-12% embedding CPU), contacts, and backup shift snippet. Backup shift plan uses `infra shift --pool ded-novaplex-backup --pct 100`.

sre-tom: Also request a short preflight at T-30m: run `/infra canary-check --tenant novaplex` and post results here.

ops-lee: Runbook excerpt for node failure:
```
- if >=2 workers failing health check -> trigger pool shift to ded-novaplex-backup
- notify #incidents and oncall
- if issues persist 15m after shift -> initiate rollback to v3.5.2
- rollback command: `/deploy rollback --tenant novaplex --version v3.5.2 --force`
```

deploy-bot: SCHEDULED: 2026-04-02T02:00:00Z for novaplex v3.6.0 (canary 2% 15m)
PREDEPLOY NOTES:
 - pins: BlueHarbor -> v3.5.2 for 48h post-deploy
 - alerts: #incidents, #ops-night
 - rollback thresholds set
 - runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/novaplex-rollout

pm-ana: PM ack, BlueHarbor pin confirmed, release notes good to go. :white_check_mark:

ops-lee: Ops ack, I'll be oncall and reachable. :eyes:

sre-tom: SRE ack, will run preflight synthetic and watch metrics. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: DEPLOYBOT: will stream status during rollout to this channel. Good luck! :rocket:
